root.label: March 2026 UMass Poll civic cohesion findings

events.label: March 2026 UMass Poll civic cohesion findings

slots.name: commonality overall
slots.sentence: Nearly three-quarters of Americans—74%—believe their fellow citizens have more in common than what divides them.

slots.name: proud milestone
slots.sentence: Only 37% describe it as “a proud national milestone,”

slots.name: anniversary attention
slots.sentence: nearly one-quarter (24%) say they do not think much about it.

slots.name: symbolic anniversary
slots.sentence: Another 18% regard it as largely symbolic.

slots.name: shared nation
slots.sentence: Nearly two-thirds (63%) agree that the United States is one nation with a shared history and common future and should never be divided.

slots.name: declaration ideals
slots.sentence: A clear majority (59%) say the ideals expressed in the Declaration of Independence still guide the country in meaningful ways.

slots.name: achieved ideals
slots.sentence: Fifty-seven percent say the country has achieved its founding ideals either “a great deal” or “a moderate amount.”

slots.name: Democrat commonality
slots.sentence: Importantly, almost equal shares of Democrats (79%) and Republicans (76%) believe Americans have more in common than what divides them.

slots.name: Republican commonality
slots.sentence: Importantly, almost equal shares of Democrats (79%) and Republicans (76%) believe Americans have more in common than what divides them.

slots.name: Democrat declaration
slots.sentence: A majority of Democrats (51%) compared to three-quarters of Republicans (75%) say the declaration’s ideals still guide the country in meaningful ways.

slots.name: Republican declaration
slots.sentence: A majority of Democrats (51%) compared to three-quarters of Republicans (75%) say the declaration’s ideals still guide the country in meaningful ways.

slots.name: Democrat shared nation
slots.sentence: Likewise, 63% of Democrats and 75% of Republicans agree that the United States remains one nation with a shared history and common future.

slots.sentence: Likewise, 63% of Democrats and 75% of Republicans agree that the United States remains one nation with a shared history and common future.
